text:
nora lim: hi team — adoption finalized sooner than expected. placement date is 2026-06-14. i need to start parental leave then but also have an international move planned the following week. what paperwork and timing should i follow?
michelle (People Ops): congrats Nora! for adoption we offer 12 weeks parental leave (paid per policy). two immediate asks: 1) submit Adoption Leave Request form with placement docs, 2) indicate any international travel so Legal can review reentry/visa impacts. link: https://intranet.redwood/care/adoption-leave
nora lim: thanks. payroll cutoff is Mon — will submitting late affect pay start date?
samira (Benefits): payroll note: if form + placement certificate received before cutoff we can start leave on 6/14 and pay the next cycle. if after cutoff, first paid cycle shifts one pay period. please upload placement certificate and bank info for benefit top-ups.
inan (typo)
ivan (Relocation): relocation here — if your move is company-assisted, submit the Relocation Intent form now and flag the adoption placement date. we can coordinate shipment timing so it doesn't conflict with initial leave. relocation approvals can take 5-7 business days.
nora lim: it's a personal move not company-assisted, but immigration paperwork for my spouse might require employer letter. can Legal help?
legal (Legal): yes. we can provide an employer verification letter confirming employment and approved parental leave dates. if spouse needs dependent visa processing, include the draft request in your form and we'll expedite. also confirm any cross-border taxation or paid-leave implications with Benefits.
tara (Manager): Tara here — i can approve the leave and hold your review window. Nora, do you want a phased return option (4 week ramp) when you come back? we can also arrange an interim backup owner for your critical tickets.
nora lim: phased return would be helpful. also worried about equity vesting during leave — will that pause or continue?
samira (Benefits): equity vesting continues per grant schedule for paid parental leave. if you take unpaid leave beyond the policy, that could impact service months. we'll confirm specifics when you submit the form.
michelle (People Ops): checklist for you: 1) Adoption placement certificate, 2) Adoption Leave Request form (dates + travel plans), 3) If spouse/partner needs visa letter, request via Legal, 4) Manager approval for phased return/backfill. We'll fast-track the forms if you note "placement imminent".
nora lim: thanks — one more: can i request a small childcare stipend for initial placement-related expenses?
samira (Benefits): yes we have a one-time "placement assistance" reimbursement up to $1,000 for adoption-related expenses. attach receipts on the expense portal and choose reimbursement code "Adoption-Placement". processed within two payroll cycles.
nora lim: amazing. filing forms now and tagging Tara + Legal. appreciate the swift help. :heart:
